Maha Chandanadi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17 edition, 662. 
 Introduction 
 Maha Chandanadi Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of fruitful herbs. This formulation is known to treat problems related with high temperature and weakness. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Safed Chandan – Santalum album 
 Agar – Gelidium corneum 
 Talisa Patra – Abies webbiana 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Narvi 
 Padam Kashtha 
 Haridra – Curcuma longa 
 Nagarmotha – Cyperus rotundus 
 Kachur – Curcuma zedoaria 
 Laksha 
 Lal chandan – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Bharangi – Clerodendrum serratum 
 Vasa patra – Adhatoda vasica 
 Kateri – Solanum surattense 
 Khareti – Sida cordifolia 
 Giloe -Tinospora cordifolia 
 Shilaras 
 Safed chandan – Santalum album 
 Kapur – Cinnamomum Camphora 
 Ela – Plectranthus amboinicus 
 Laung – Syzygium aromaticum 
 Kesar – Crocus sativus 
 Kasturi – Curcuma aromatica 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Take ingredients number 1 to 11 up to 60 grams, 12 to 16 up to 960 grams and 17 to 23 up to 9 grams, 22 litres water and 5 litres til oil. 
 Now first take ingredients from number 1 to 11 and prepare its kalka (paste). 
 Now take ingredients 12 to 16 and make its decoction. 
 Now put all the above preparations in container and cook to produce oil. 
 After oil formulation, added other ingredients in powder form from number 17 to 21. 
 Now in last grind kesar and kasturi in rectified spirit and add to oil. 
 
 Dose 
 Take the oil and rub on body and head. 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic fever tuberculosis 
 Weak limbs 
 General debility 
 Sensation of extremities 
 Headaches 
 Neuralgia 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
